name: CSS Admonition
note: R13.34, Captain's Module R4 SSD p.73 (PDF p.74). The Destroyer with its torpedo armament rebuilt around ONE plasma-G instead of TWO plasma-F, and that trade is the whole ship: a single launcher 'A' in the FP arc where the DD carries A and B, for two points of BPV. Every other box on the sheet is the DD's, counted at 400 dpi rather than assumed because this is the fourth hull on the chassis: shields 20 all round (shield #1 counted in its L-shaped strip, 6 two-wide rows and 8 single, 20), C hull 10, warp 8 a side, impulse 2, APR 2, batteries 4, bridge 2, emergency 1, aux 1, transporters 2, tractors 2, labs 4, one probe with five rounds, four shuttle boxes, excess damage 4, turn mode B, command rating 4, breakdown 6, crew 24 in the DD's own 10/10/4 grid, boarding parties 8, and the damage tracks 6-5-3-1-0, 0-1-3-5-9, 2-2-2-0. NOT THE DDL, WHICH ALSO CARRIES PLASMA-G: the leader pays for its pair with a centre APR pair, 30/24 shields, crew 28 and no probe at all. This hull pays with a launcher. POINT VALUE = 94 is a single number, not the split the CVE, SC, SR and HSC carry, so there is no epv here; 94 less the 4 for going without PL-F gives the Y177 hull at 90. The sheet's two rear-firing plasma-F are the refit and nothing else - 'WITHOUT THE PL-F REFIT, DELETE PL-Fs "B" AND "C"' - and it cites R13.1C by name for the restrictions on them. The pseudo-plasma box lists a pseudo for A alone, which is R13.1C's 'no PPTs on the rear-firing torpedoes' drawn rather than written. No balcony note on this sheet, as on the DD. The Y180 Sabot refit (+3) is absent as elsewhere: FP11.0 is in Module R10, out of scope.

refits.name: PL-F refit
refits.label: Plasma-F
refits._note: Sheet: WITHOUT THE PL-F REFIT, DELETE PL-Fs 'B' AND 'C'. Named designators because the hull's own torpedo is A - the plasma-G - and these two are the whole refit. B is to port (L, LR) and C to starboard (R, RR), which is a letter earlier than the DD's C and D for the same two arcs: on this hull the forward pair is a single launcher, so the rear-firing torpedoes start at B. R13.1C's rear-firing kind, flagged iscRearFiring, and this sheet cites R13.1C by name.
